## Goal

What capability, defect, or constraint does this pull request address?

## Scope

What is intentionally changed? What is explicitly out of scope?

## Delete / simplify

What unnecessary code, dependency, step, or abstraction was removed or avoided? If none, why is the added complexity necessary?

## Acceptance criteria

State the observable conditions that define success.

## Changes

Summarize the smallest meaningful implementation change.

## Evidence

What is the simplest reliable evidence that proves the acceptance criteria? List the commands, observations, traces, contracts, static checks, tests, evals, or production evidence that actually matter.

Do not add tests only to fill this section.

## Documentation

Which documented behavior, interface, decision, architecture boundary, operating procedure, or project status changed? Write `None` only when documentation remains accurate.

## Security and failure modes

Describe changed trust boundaries, privileges, external input, secrets, destructive actions, dependency or supply-chain risk, or new failure modes. Write `None` only after considering them.

## Rollback

How can this change be disabled, reverted, or migrated back if it causes a regression?
